name: Cui Yifei
source:
Leader of the Third Unified Front’s Bao Feng test flight. Loves to win more than anything, and strongly sees Idol and Argus as rivals. Her TSF fighting style is aggressive, to match her personality, and she specializes in close-range sword combat. Her men call her Big Sis as a show of respect.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
